P1: 华蓝市 is a beautiful city with flowing water and blooming flowers. It is located between 4号道路, 24号道路, 9号道路, and 5号道路. The local Bike Shop has expanded its business to a second location in 满金市. The Cerulean Gym stands in the city center, and a mysterious cave is located on the north edge of town.
D2: Cerulean Gym; in a pile of inflatable tubes near the back of the Gym (hidden; does not respond to Dowsing MCHN)
D3: From Gym Leader Misty, after returning the Machine Part and defeating her
D4: East-southeast of the Cerulean Cave entrance, on the rock wall; accessed via Route 24 (hidden; requires 冲浪)
P2: Upon entering the Gym, a man in a dark uniform runs into you. He stops for a moment to make sure that you are not hurt, then mentions how it would be a problem if he was seen by anyone. Suddenly realizing that he has indeed already been seen, he orders you to forget about him before rushing off.
P3: 24号道路 stretches north from 华蓝市 to 25号道路. Most of the area is occupied by a river and the Nugget Bridge that crosses it.
P4: The man dressed in black can be found regrouping on Nugget Bridge. When he first notices you, he tries to blend in with a nearby couple. Confront him, and he explains that his secret mission was to disable the Power Plant's generator in order to cause mass panic. He makes you a deal: defeat him in battle, and he will reveal the key to his mission.
P5: After the battle, he reveals that he hid the 机械零件 near a pile of inflatable tubes in Cerulean Gym. He shrugs off his loss, saying that his Team Rocket friends will come from Johto to get revenge for him, but quickly flees when he realizes that no help is coming.
P6: The Gym Leader has stepped out for the moment and there are no Gym Trainers around. Search the inflatable tubes near the back of the Gym to recover the 机械零件.
P7: Return to the Power Plant and speak to the Manager to deliver the 机械零件. He is grateful to see it returned, and rewards you with 招式学习器57（充电光束）.
P8: With the generator restored and the Power Plant back online, there are certain sidequests that may now be completed.
P9: Return to 金黄市 and visit the character's house in the northwest part of the city. Speak to her to learn that she has lost her favorite 皮皮玩偶, and believes it to be located somewhere in 枯叶市.
P10: Return to 枯叶市 and visit the Pokémon Fan Club on the west side of town. Speak to the man with the 皮皮 皮皮玩偶 to explain the situation. He has not yet been able to catch his own Clefairy, and so brought a doll that he had found instead. When he realizes that it is missed by its owner, he gladly gives up the 遗失物.
P11: When you leave the Fan Club building, you are approached by a man who introduces himself as Steven, the Champion from the distant Hoenn region. He asks if you have heard of a Pokémon called 拉帝亚斯 / 拉帝欧斯, and explains that he is investigating why the Hoenn-native Pokémon decided to travel all the way here to Kanto. He goes on to say that the Pokémon has a connection to the gem-like 心之水滴, and wonders if this may have something to do with it. He turns to leave in the hopes that your paths cross again.
P12: After this meeting, the Pokégear Map tracks the Pokémon's movements around the Kanto region.
P13: Speak to the girl to return the 遗失物. She rewards you with a 磁浮列车自由票, a ticket used to board the Magnet Train. Her old home was torn down to make room for the train station, and she received the item from a train company representative as compensation. Now that the Power Plant is operational again, the Magnet Train runs between Johto's 满金市 and Kanto's 金黄市 twenty-four hours a day, seven days a week. As the S.S. Aqua sails only on certain days, riding the train is the most convenient means of travel between the two regions.
P14: Return to 紫苑镇's Radio Tower and speak to the Manager near the north wall. With the power back on and the tower broadcasting normally, he never lost his job. Realizing that it is you that he has to thank for this, he rewards you with an EXPN Card. This expansion card allows the Pokégear to tune into the remaining radio program, the Poké Flute Channel. To do so, the user must manually move the round indicator to the top of the circular field.
P15: 25号道路 leads eastward from 24号道路. The path winds its way through a forest before it ends overlooking the sea. The Sea Cottage is located on the east side.
M3: Headbutt The four trees at the northwest corner of Route 25.
D5: On the ledge in the northwest corner of the route (hidden)
D6: Northeast part of the tree maze (requires 居合斩)
D7: From Ace Trainer Kevin, as a reward for defeating the six Trainers
P16: The first Trainer encountered here, School Kid Dudley, is part of a group of six and challenges you to defeat them all. Fight each one as you move eastward, ending with Lass Shannon, to complete the challenge. Defeat Super Nerd Pat as well, then speak to Ace Trainer Kevin to receive your prize: a 金珠. After seeing how you battle, he wants to know how well he would fare, and draws you into battle.
P17: Upon reaching the cape, you find the Cerulean Gym Leader on a date nearby. Her date runs off and she starts to yell, until she spots your Johto Badges. She states that you must be strong if you earned all eight Badges, and invites you to Cerulean Gym. She introduces herself as Misty before heading back to town.
P18: The Sea Cottage belongs to Bill, but his grandfather is housesitting while he is away. The elderly man enjoys hearing about all of the Pokémon that his grandson meets. Speak to him, and he describes a certain Pokémon that he would like to see. If shown a Pokémon of the correct species, he rewards you with an Evolution stone.

P19: The Cerulean Gym specializes in 水 Pokémon. Water-type moves are super effective against 火-, 地面-, and 岩石 Pokémon, while Water-type Pokémon are weak to 电- and 草 moves.
P20: The Gym features a large swimming pool. Challengers may advance by either going around the pool or by using 冲浪 to cross it. The second Sailor, Eddie, may inadvertently block off the back of the building as he draws an approaching challenger into battle. This means that most will likely need to cross at least the far end of the pool, surfing past Swimmers and around lane dividers to reach the Gym Leader.
P21: 电 attacks are a major vulnerability for Misty's team. Only the 地面 沼王 is unaffected by Electric moves, and can deal increased damage to Electric Pokémon with 地震. If 求雨 takes effect, 水 moves receive a power boost and 打雷 has its 命中率 increased to 100%. 草 moves will do equally well, but both 拉普拉斯 and 宝石海星 can counter Grass Pokémon with their 冰 attacks. Alternatively, Lapras takes serious damage from 格斗- and 岩石 moves, while Starmie falters against 虫-, 幽灵-, and 恶 moves.
P22: After the battle, Misty awards you the 蓝色徽章. She also gives out 招式学习器03（水之波动） as a prize.
P23: 5号道路 is a scenic road that runs downhill from 华蓝市 to 金黄市. The first of the region's two Underground Paths begins here and runs southward underneath Saffron City to re-emerge on 6号道路.
D8: From the old woman in the former Pokémon Day Care building
P24: The Underground Path was initially blocked off, as it was unsafe to use the tunnel while the power was out.
D9: North end, five steps south of the row of three traffic cones (hidden)
D10: From the hungry man near the middle of the tunnel
D11: Middle of the tunnel, on the right-hand traffic cone (hidden)
P25: Speak to the man near the middle of the tunnel, and he mentions how it makes him mad that a place like this attracts mean people who would start trouble. He then notices your RageCandyBar, and asks if he can have it. Let him have the candy bar and his mood improves after eating it. He rewards you with 招式学习器64（大爆炸） as thanks.
